اخترقا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَقَا (iḵtaraqā) /ix.ta.ra.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# اُخْتُرِقَا (uḵturiqā) /ux.tu.ri.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# اِخْتَرِقَا (iḵtariqā) /ix.ta.ri.qaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
